summary: Iteration 6 (Home tab + Avatars/Profile dialog). Backend: added TestProfileEnrichment (5 new tests) covering GET /api/users/{id} shape/404/admin-guard, GET /api/applications carries candidate_picture, GET /api/chat/conversations carries picture. Full regression: 41/41 pytest passing. Frontend: verified all 8 requested UI flows end-to-end via Playwright with real captcha+OTP login. Candidate: sidebar-home present and default section is 'home'; candidate-home renders 5 job cards; 3 show Postuler (home-apply-<id>), 1 shows Voir (home-view-<id>) — the pre-applied Data Analyst offer correctly displays already-applied status/badge; home-job-search filters cards (5 -> 2 for 'data'); clicking Postuler navigates to /jobs/<id>#postuler and the application form is rendered. Admin: nav-applications table renders app-avatar-<appId> on every row (9 avatars found), clicking avatar opens candidate-profile-dialog with profile-name-heading, expertise chips, stats, applications list and interviews; opening a candidature detail exposes view-full-profile-btn that opens the same dialog; nav-candidates table has 31 open-profile-<userId> buttons wired to the dialog; nav-messages conversation list plus active chat header (chat-open-profile) both open the dialog. No blockers.

issues: A11y: Radix DialogContent emits 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' warning (DialogHeader is sr-only but no <DialogDescription>). Not blocking; consider adding an sr-only DialogDescription for screen readers.

action_items: (Optional) Add an sr-only <DialogDescription> to CandidateProfileDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_user_detail returns applications/interviews/contracts by candidate_id — good. But interviews sort key uses ('date',1) then ('time',1) as string sort; works because both are ISO-like strings ('YYYY-MM-DD' + 'HH:MM'), keep as-is.

applications endpoint fetches user pictures with a single $in query — efficient. However candidate_picture is set to None when the user was deleted; frontend Avatar handles empty src by falling back to initials, so this is safe.

CandidateProfileDialog.jsx fires api.get(`/users/${userId}`) but silently swallows errors (.catch(() => {})) — user sees an infinite spinner if the request 404s or 401s. Consider surfacing an error state.

AdminDashboard.js applications table row still has row-level onClick to open the detail; the avatar button uses stopPropagation-less onClick meaning it also opens the row detail. Verified empirically the dialog wins (React portal on top), but consider adding e.stopPropagation() on Avatar onClick to make it deterministic.
server.py still 1499 lines — recommend splitting into routers (auth, users, applications, chat, contracts, interviews).
CandidateDashboard JobsHome fetches jobs/apps from parent — good; but 'apps' is filtered client-side by job_id/status meaning even removed jobs stay listed until parent refreshes. Non-blocking.
